thread:
samir: Heads-up 1: a strategic customer asked for a tightly-scoped "Pin Guarantee": they want explicit acceptance gates, a documented emergency unpin flow, and migration escrow credits. Can we outline a minimal GA spec?
julie: Quick bullets from Sales would help.
samir: Copied: tenant pin up to 180 days, EU-only residency option, latency cap (p95), migration credit if we force-retire, and an audit trail.
frank: Proposal for GA: default TTL 90d, paid extension to 180d; two tiers: Standard (shared infra) and Reserved (dedicated slots). Reserve requires an ops approval ticket.
norma: Bench acceptance: canonical harness = seq512, 200 samples, concurrency 4. Gates: gen p95 <= 160ms (Reserved) / <= 240ms (Standard). Embedding drift (cos sim) <= 3.5%. Cost delta <= 2.0x.
samir: Important: preflight CI must run bench + golden-eval + regional smoke. If any gate fails, pin is rejected with actionable errors.
julie: API surface: rwd.pin.create(tenant, model, ttl_days, tier, strict_mode=false, pin_reason="...") -> returns pin_id + audit metadata. Console shows TTL, tier, expiry countdown.
frank: Add these registry flags: pin_allowed, pin_max_ttl, pin_tier, strict_fallback_supported. We should also add unsupported_reason for models that fail deterministic-quant checks.
oncall-bot: Created task TASK-5501: "pin-ga-spec + runbook" (assignee: frank).
frank: Emergency unpin runbook (short): 1) set pin_state=disabled -> stops new traffic; 2) issue emergency-unpin via admin CLI; 3) run fast rollback to compatible variant; 4) notify customer + page oncall. Snippet:
```
# admin quick unpin
rwd-admin pin suspend --tenant TENANT --pin PIN_ID --reason "safety"
rwd-admin pin remove --tenant TENANT --pin PIN_ID
```
Include comm templates in doc.
norma: Monitoring signals: pinned_requests, pinned_latency_p95, pinned_eval_fail_rate, pin_fallbacks. Alerts: eval_fail_rate > 2% -> P1 page. Also wire metrics into billing export with pin_tier and pin_reason.
julie: Migration credit policy: if we retire a pinned model early, customer gets X days of reserved-capacity credits (suggest 60d for first forced migration). Also provide a migration-runner CLI to automate cutover.
frank: Fallback semantics: default = attempt compatible fallback variant, then 503 if not available. If customer sets strict_mode=true at pin time, we honor strict semantics (no fallback). Document both clearly.
contracts: Legal note: include clause about upstream model changes (we can ask customer to unpin if upstream causes safety/quality failure). Also require audit fields: pinned_by, approval_ticket, pin_reason, signed_sow_id for Reserved tier.
samir: UX detail: Console should surface a compatibility check before allowing pin: run quick bench (50 samples) and show pass/fail inline. Also show "request extension" button that creates approval workflow for Reserved.
julie: Canary plan: start with 8 tenants (mix EU/US), monitor for 21 days. Success criteria: no paging incidents, pinned_p95 within 10% of baseline, eval_fail_rate < 1.5%.
frank: Implementation owners: frank -> spec + registry flags, norma -> bench harness + CI, julie -> console UX + API, contracts -> legal clauses. Draft due in 6 business days.
oncall-bot: Tracking doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/pin-ga-minispec (access: product, eng, legal)

samir: One more: add "pin_reason" freeform field required on create and included in audit + billing export. Helps ops & billing reconcile.
contracts: We'll prepare a short SOW template for Reserved pins and an emergency-unpin clause.
samir: Cool 1. We'll use this thread as working notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
